rules.invariant: Money state, provider objects, idempotency keys, and entitlements remain tenant-bound across request, webhook, retry, refund, and payout paths.
rules.required_verification: Cross-tenant provider-object, webhook replay, and entitlement mutation tests.

rules.invariant: Personal data reaches models, tools, memory, and traces only through purpose-bound minimized projections.
rules.required_verification: PII field-canary tests across prompt, tool, memory, trace, and provider failure paths.

rules.invariant: Retrieval, memory, caches, tools, and traces preserve tenant scope before model ranking or action.
rules.required_verification: Cross-tenant retrieval, memory poisoning, cache collision, and tool-argument tests.

rules.invariant: Upload keys, scanners, processing jobs, derived artifacts, and downloads preserve tenant ownership.
rules.required_verification: Cross-tenant upload, derived-object, scanner callback, and download tests.

rules.invariant: API object, function, property, batch, and pagination authority is evaluated inside authenticated tenant scope.
rules.required_verification: Cross-tenant ID, batch, nested-object, cursor, and role tests.

rules.invariant: Support access cannot silently widen from one case and tenant to another.
rules.required_verification: Case-to-tenant binding, tenant-switch, bulk search, impersonation, and audit tests.

rules.invariant: Delegated SaaS grants cannot export personal data beyond declared tenant, purpose, fields, or volume.
rules.required_verification: Scope, field, tenant, bulk-export, revocation, and anomaly tests.

rules.invariant: Build identity cannot obtain cloud authority outside the exact repository, workflow, ref, environment, and artifact intent.
rules.required_verification: OIDC subject/audience, fork, ref, environment, and artifact-substitution tests.

rules.invariant: Model output can propose but cannot independently authorize or confirm an irreversible transaction.
rules.required_verification: Prompt-injection, tool-call, approval binding, and replay tests at the irreversible boundary.
